title: Pokémon card prices by generation: compare and project
subject: card
scope: Buying one graded Pokémon card from the US market and holding it in Singapore. It covers six popular cards, grouped by the generation they were printed in: Generation 1 (Base Set, 1999), Generation 8 (Sword & Shield, 2021–22) and Generation 9 (Scarlet & Violet, 2023). Each card's cost has three parts. The purchase price is the PriceCharting guide value for that grade on 26 Oct 2026. Import is postage, 1% transit insurance and 9% Singapore GST on the CIF value, since every card here is over the S$400 import relief limit. Collectibles insurance is about 0.65% of the card's value a year. Each card's yearly increase comes from its own late-2024 sale and its Oct 2026 price. Pick a later start year to see the projected price of buying then.
limits: This page covers 6 cards, not the 100 in the request. It has no reliable dated price history for 100 cards, and the format allows at most 6 options. The yearly increase comes from about 2 years of data, from Dec 2024 to Oct 2026, not 3. I found no Oct 2023 prices I could check, because PriceCharting's chart, Card Ladder and PSA's auction records would not load. The late-2024 points are single eBay sales reported by Pikawiz, which does not verify them. Every card actually rose 31% to 68% a year, but the calculator caps any rate at 15% a year and never goes below 0%. Its projections are therefore a capped extrapolation, not a forecast. Card prices can fall: the Obsidian Flames Charizard is down about 6% since Sep 2025. Not included: eBay or Fanatics buyer's premiums, PSA grading (the cards are already graded), selling fees when you sell, a safe deposit box (DBS X-Small, S$190.75 a year), and currency moves. Prices are in USD and converted at a fixed rate.
fxNote: USD/SGD 1.2787 on 26 Oct 2026 (Trading Economics), so S$1 = US$0.782.

components.label: Collectibles insurance (0.65% of value a year)

items.name: Charizard 4/102, Base Set Unlimited
items.notes: Price: the PriceCharting Grade 9 guide was US$3,595.95, read 26 Oct 2026 (about S$4,598). PSA 9 sales between 3 and 22 Oct 2026 were US$3,451 to 4,297. Other 2026 guides are lower: Pokemon Price Tracker gave US$1,800 to 2,400 on 1 Jun 2026. The 2024 point is a PSA 9 sale of US$1,375 on 16 Dec 2024, listed on Pikawiz (pikawiz.com/card/baseset/charizard/4) as an unverified eBay sale. That works out to 61.7% a year from Dec 2024 to Oct 2026, capped at 15% here. History values are insurance at 0.65% of those prices. No Oct 2023 or Oct 2025 PSA 9 price could be confirmed. Import: estimated US$35 courier postage, plus 1% transit insurance and 9% GST on CIF. Insurance: 0.65% a year, the middle of US$0.50 to 0.80 per US$100 (pregradecards.com guide, Jun 2026).

items.name: Blastoise 2/102, Base Set Unlimited
items.notes: Price: the PriceCharting Grade 9 guide was US$948.92, read 26 Oct 2026 (about S$1,213). PSA 9 sales between 1 and 22 Oct 2026 were US$881 to 1,351, so the guide sits at the low end. The 2024 point is a PSA 9 Unlimited sale of US$425 on 17 Dec 2024, listed on Pikawiz (pikawiz.com/card/baseset/blastoise/2) as an unverified eBay sale. That works out to 49.4% a year, capped at 15% here. No 2023 or 2025 price could be confirmed. Import: estimated US$35 postage, plus 1% transit insurance and 9% GST on CIF. Insurance: 0.65% of value a year.

items.name: Umbreon VMAX Alt Art 215/203, Evolving Skies
items.notes: Price: the PriceCharting PSA 10 guide was US$3,711.20, read 26 Oct 2026 (about S$4,746). 13 PSA 10 sales between 21 and 25 Oct 2026 were US$3,350 to 4,500. Dittobase gave US$3,750 on 23 Oct 2026. The 2024 point is a PSA 10 sale of US$2,150 on 30 Dec 2024, listed on Pikawiz (pikawiz.com/card/evolvingskies/umbreonvmax/215) as an unverified eBay sale. That works out to 31.4% a year, capped at 15% here. Search snippets suggest Aug to Oct 2025 PSA 10 sales of about US$2,800 to 3,950, but I could not open those pages, so they are not used. Import: estimated US$35 postage, plus 1% transit insurance and 9% GST. Insurance: 0.65% of value a year.

items.name: Giratina V Alt Art 186/196, Lost Origin
items.notes: Price: the PriceCharting PSA 10 guide was US$3,094.50, read 26 Oct 2026 (about S$3,957). 13 PSA 10 sales between 15 and 25 Oct 2026 were US$2,951 to 3,250. The 2024 point is a PSA 10 sale of US$1,100 on 31 Dec 2024, listed on Pikawiz (pikawiz.com/card/lostorigin/giratinav/186) as an unverified eBay sale. BGS and CGC 10 sales on PriceCharting in Oct 2024 were US$1,200 to 1,575, which is consistent. That works out to 67.7% a year, capped at 15% here. Import: estimated US$35 postage, plus 1% transit insurance and 9% GST. Insurance: 0.65% of value a year.

items.name: Charizard ex SIR 199/165, Scarlet & Violet 151
items.notes: Price: the PriceCharting PSA 10 guide was US$1,288.33, read 26 Oct 2026 (about S$1,647). PSA 10 sales between 20 and 25 Oct 2026 were US$1,100 to 1,399. PokeValues gave a 90-day PSA 10 median of US$1,288 on 25 Oct 2026. The 2024 point is a PSA 10 sale of US$660 on 30 Dec 2024, listed on Pikawiz (pikawiz.com/card/151/charizardex/199) as an unverified eBay sale. That works out to 39.7% a year, capped at 15% here. The card was released in Sep 2023, and no Oct 2023 PSA 10 price could be confirmed. Import: estimated US$35 postage, plus 1% transit insurance and 9% GST. Insurance: 0.65% of value a year.

items.name: Charizard ex SIR 223/197, Obsidian Flames
items.notes: Price: the PriceCharting PSA 10 guide was US$657.39, read 26 Oct 2026 (about S$841). PSA 10 sales between 22 and 26 Oct 2026 were US$615 to 722. The 2025 point comes from Fanatics Collect, read 26 Oct 2026, which sold PSA 10 copies for US$699 on 26 and 27 Sep 2025, then US$550 on 6 Feb 2026. The 2024 point is a PSA 10 sale of US$355 on 30 Dec 2024, listed on Pikawiz as an unverified eBay sale. That works out to 36.1% a year from Dec 2024, capped at 15% here, but -6% since Sep 2025. Import: estimated US$35 postage, plus 1% transit insurance and 9% GST. At about S$894 with shipping, the card is over the S$400 relief limit. Insurance: 0.65% of value a year.
